player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Balcony and Guest room, repeatedly going back and forth between them. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to continue exploring other rooms without properly backtracking and removing the visited rooms from the graph. Next time, I will make sure to properly backtrack and remove the visited rooms from the graph when I return to a room I have already visited. I will also try to explore new rooms more systematically, for example, by going east from the Craft room and Utility room, and by going south from the Mudroom. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead.
